theorem lg_target : StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) fun x => √x := by
  intros x y hxy
  have h : 0 < x ∨ 0 < y := or.inl (le_antisymm (le_zero_iff.mpr (le_refl 0)) (le_zero_iff.mpr (le_refl 0)))
  cases h with hx hy
  constructor
  rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  apply strictConcaveOn_negMulLog
  rw [Real.negMulLog, Real.negMulLog]
  exact (mul_lt_mul_left (le_of_lt hx) (le_of_lt hy)).1
  exact (mul_lt_mul_left (le_of_lt hx) (le_of_lt hy)).2
